# Authentication

* API Key (X-Nomad-Token)
    - Parameter Name: **X-Nomad-Token**, in: header.

<h1 id="nomad-acl">ACL</h1>

## PostACLBootstrap

<a id="opIdPostACLBootstrap"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/acl/bootstrap \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /acl/bootstrap`

<h3 id="postaclbootstrap-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "AccessorID": "string",
  "CreateIndex": 0,
  "CreateTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "ExpirationTTL": 0,
  "ExpirationTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "Global": true,
  "ModifyIndex": 0,
  "Name": "string",
  "Policies": [
    "string"
  ],
  "Roles": [
    {
      "ID": "string",
      "Name": "string"
    }
  ],
  "SecretID": "string",
  "Type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="postaclbootstrap-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[ACLToken](#schemaacltoken)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetACLPolicies

<a id="opIdGetACLPolicies"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/acl/policies \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /acl/policies`

<h3 id="getaclpolicies-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "CreateIndex": 0,
    "Description": "string",
    "ModifyIndex": 0,
    "Name": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="getaclpolicies-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

<h3 id="getaclpolicies-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ACLPolicyListStub](#schemaaclpolicyliststub)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|

X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetACLTokens

<a id="opIdGetACLTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/acl/tokens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /acl/tokens`

<h3 id="getacltokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|

<h3 id="getacltokens-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ACLTokenListStub](#schemaacltokenliststub)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|

<h3 id="getallocation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[Allocation](#schemaallocation)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetAllocationServices

<a id="opIdGetAllocationServices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/allocation/string/services \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /allocation/{allocID}/services`

<h3 id="getallocationservices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|
|allocID|path|string|true|Allocation ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "Address": "string",
    "AllocID": "string",
    "CreateIndex": 0,
    "Datacenter": "string",
    "ID": "string",
    "JobID": "string",
    "ModifyIndex": 0,
    "Namespace": "string",
    "NodeID": "string",
    "Port": 0,
    "ServiceName": "string",
    "Tags": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
]
```

## PostAllocationStop

<a id="opIdPostAllocationStop"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/allocation/string/stop \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /allocation/{allocID}/stop`

<h3 id="postallocationstop-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|
|allocID|path|string|true|Allocation ID.|
|no_shutdown_delay|query|boolean|false|Flag indicating whether to delay shutdown when requesting an allocation stop.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "EvalID": "string",
  "Index": 0
}
```

### Response Headers

<h3 id="getjob-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[Job](#schemajob)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

<h3 id="postjob-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|jobName|path|string|true|The job identifier.|
|body|body|[JobRegisterRequest](#schemajobregisterrequest)|true|none|
|» EnforceIndex|body|boolean|false|none|
|» EvalPriority|body|integer|false|none|
|» Job|body|[Job](#schemajob)|false|none|
|» JobModifyIndex|body|integer|false|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» PolicyOverride|body|boolean|false|none|
|» PreserveCounts|body|boolean|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "EvalCreateIndex": 0,
  "EvalID": "string",
  "JobModifyIndex": 0,
  "KnownLeader": true,
  "LastContact": 0,
  "LastIndex": 0,
  "NextToken": "string",
  "RequestTime": 0,
  "Warnings": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="postjob-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[JobRegisterResponse](#schemajobregisterresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## DeleteJob

<a id="opIdDeleteJob"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/job/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /job/{jobName}`

<h3 id="deletejob-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|jobName|path|string|true|The job identifier.|
|purge|query|boolean|false|Boolean flag indicating whether to purge allocations of the job after deleting.|
|global|query|boolean|false|Boolean flag indicating whether the operation should apply to all instances of the job globally.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "EvalCreateIndex": 0,
  "EvalID": "string",
  "JobModifyIndex": 0,
  "KnownLeader": true,
  "LastContact": 0,
  "LastIndex": 0,
  "NextToken": "string",
  "RequestTime": 0
}
```

<h3 id="deletejob-responses">Responses</h3>

|200|OK||[JobDeregisterResponse](#schemajobderegisterresponse)|

|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|

## GetJobAllocations

<a id="opIdGetJobAllocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/job/string/allocations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /job/{jobName}/allocations`

<h3 id="getjoballocations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|

<h3 id="getjobevaluations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[Evaluation](#schemaevaluation)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## PostJobPeriodicForce

<a id="opIdPostJobPeriodicForce"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/job/string/periodic/force \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /job/{jobName}/periodic/force`

<h3 id="postjobperiodicforce-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|jobName|path|string|true|The job identifier.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "EvalCreateIndex": 0,
  "EvalID": "string",
  "Index": 0
}
```

<h3 id="postjobperiodicforce-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[PeriodicForceResponse](#schemaperiodicforceresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|

<h3 id="postjobplan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|jobName|path|string|true|The job identifier.|
|body|body|[JobPlanRequest](#schemajobplanrequest)|true|none|
|» Diff|body|boolean|false|none|
|» Job|body|[Job](#schemajob)|false|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» PolicyOverride|body|boolean|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="getjobsummary-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[JobSummary](#schemajobsummary)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetJobVersions

<a id="opIdGetJobVersions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/job/string/versions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /job/{jobName}/versions`

<h3 id="getjobversions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|
|jobName|path|string|true|The job identifier.|
|diffs|query|boolean|false|Boolean flag indicating whether to compute job diffs.|

|---|---|---|---|---|

X-Nomad-Token

## GetJobs

<a id="opIdGetJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /jobs`

<h3 id="getjobs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|body|body|[JobRegisterRequest](#schemajobregisterrequest)|true|none|
|» EnforceIndex|body|boolean|false|none|
|» EvalPriority|body|integer|false|none|
|» Job|body|[Job](#schemajob)|false|none|
|» JobModifyIndex|body|integer|false|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» PolicyOverride|body|boolean|false|none|
|» PreserveCounts|body|boolean|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|


<h3 id="registerjob-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[JobRegisterResponse](#schemajobregisterresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## PostJobParse

<a id="opIdPostJobParse"></a>

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/jobs/parse \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Canonicalize": true,
    "JobHCL": "string",
    "hclv1": true
  }'
```

<h3 id="getvolume-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[CSIVolume](#schemacsivolume)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

<h3 id="postvolumeregistration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|volumeId|path|string|true|Volume unique identifier.|
|body|body|[CSIVolumeRegisterRequest](#schemacsivolumeregisterrequest)|true|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|
|» Volumes|body|[[CSIVolume](#schemacsivolume)]|false|none|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## DeleteVolumeRegistration

<a id="opIdDeleteVolumeRegistration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/volume/csi/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /volume/csi/{volumeId}`

<h3 id="deletevolumeregistration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|volumeId|path|string|true|Volume unique identifier.|
|force|query|string|false|Used to force the de-registration of a volume.|

<h3 id="createvolume-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|volumeId|path|string|true|Volume unique identifier.|
|action|path|string|true|The action to perform on the Volume (create, detach, delete).|
|body|body|[CSIVolumeCreateRequest](#schemacsivolumecreaterequest)|true|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|
|» Volumes|body|[[CSIVolume](#schemacsivolume)]|false|none|

<h3 id="createvolume-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetVolumes

<a id="opIdGetVolumes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/volumes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /volumes`

<h3 id="getvolumes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|
|node_id|query|string|false|Filters volume lists by node ID.|
|plugin_id|query|string|false|Filters volume lists by plugin ID.|
|type|query|string|false|Filters volume lists to a specific type.|

<h3 id="postvolume-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|idempotency_token|query|string|false|Can be used to ensure operations are only run once.|
|body|body|[CSIVolumeRegisterRequest](#schemacsivolumeregisterrequest)|true|none|
|» Namespace|body|string|false|none|
|» Region|body|string|false|none|
|» SecretID|body|string|false|none|
|» Volumes|body|[[CSIVolume](#schemacsivolume)]|false|none|

<h3 id="postvolume-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-Nomad-Index|integer||A unique identifier representing the current state of the requested resource. On a new Nomad cluster the value of this index starts at 1.|
|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
X-Nomad-Token
</aside>

## GetExternalVolumes

<a id="opIdGetExternalVolumes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:4646/v1/volumes/external \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Nomad-Token: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /volumes/external`

<h3 id="getexternalvolumes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified region.|
|namespace|query|string|false|Filters results based on the specified namespace.|
|index|header|integer|false|If set, wait until query exceeds given index. Must be provided with WaitParam.|
|wait|query|string|false|Provided with IndexParam to wait for change.|
|stale|query|string|false|If present, results will include stale reads.|
|prefix|query|string|false|Constrains results to jobs that start with the defined prefix|
|X-Nomad-Token|header|string|false|A Nomad ACL token.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|next_token|query|string|false|Indicates where to start paging for queries that support pagination.|
|plugin_id|query|string|false|Filters volume lists by plugin ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "NextToken": "string",
  "Volumes": [
    {
      "CapacityBytes": 0,
      "CloneID": "string",
      "ExternalID": "string",
      "IsAbnormal": true,
      "PublishedExternalNodeIDs": [
        "string"
      ],
      "SnapshotID": "string",
      "Status": "string",
      "VolumeContext": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="getexternalvolumes-responses">Responses</h3>

|200|OK||[CSIVolumeListExternalResponse](#schemacsivolumelistexternalresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|

|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

### Response Headers

|200|X-Nomad-KnownLeader|boolean||Boolean indicating if there is a known cluster leader.|
|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|200|X-Nomad-LastContact|integer||The time in milliseconds that a server was last contacted by the leader node.|
